title: Emily Catalano | The Introvert (Full Comedy Special)
description:
Hey. This is my newest standup special. I hope you like the jokes.

If you want to see me perform in your city, the best way to do that is to sign up for my email list 👉 https://emilycomedy.com/signup

This was filmed at The Belly Up in Solana Beach, Ca.

Directed by @joemackedanz 

Thanks for all your support over the years. I couldn't make projects like this without all of y'all.

This special was self-funded. If you want to help fund the next special my Venmo is @Emilycatalano
